introduction: ERC-1077 defines an interface for gas abstraction: a user signs a message authorizing a call, and an untrusted relayer submits it for a fee in ETH or an ERC-20 token. It was proposed by Alex Van de Sande and Ricardo Guilherme Schmidt in May 2018. The account contract validates the signature via ERC-1271, runs the encoded call, and refunds the relayer for gas spent. Note: ERC-1077 is Stagnant — it has been inactive for 6+ months and may never be finalized, but remains historically or technically significant.
designPurpose: ERC-1077 was designed to remove ETH as a hard requirement for interacting with DApps. Before it, every account needed an ETH balance to pay gas, which blocked onboarding. The standard lets an account owner sign an executeGasRelay message off-chain; any relayer can then broadcast it, front the gas, and be reimbursed in the token agreed in the signed message. Standardizing the message format and the EIP-191 signing scheme lets independent relayers and wallets interoperate without trusting each other.
commonUsage: Gas relay is used by smart-contract wallets and identity contracts that let users transact without holding ETH, paying fees in a project token instead. Apps collect signed messages and settle the gas on the user's behalf, enabling sponsored or subscription-style transactions. The pattern predates and overlaps with account abstraction: much of its meta-transaction relaying model was later generalized by ERC-4337 and by native account abstraction, which see broader deployment today.
fn.executeGasRelay.desc: Executes the signed call data using the account's current nonce and pays msg.sender for the gas used, denominated in the specified gas token. Reverts when the signature is invalid or the funds are insufficient.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.execData: The encoded call the account contract should execute.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.gasPrice: The gas price to reimburse, paid in the selected gas token.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.gasLimit: The gas reserved for the relayed execution.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.gasToken: The token used to pay the gas refund; the zero address means ether.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.gasRelayer: The account that receives the gas refund; the zero address pays block.coinbase.
fn.executeGasRelay.params.signature: The EIP-191 signature (or concatenated signatures) authorizing the call.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.desc: Returns the executeGasRelay message that must be signed, packing the nonce, call data, gas parameters, gas token, and relayer into the standard byte layout.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.nonce: The execution nonce, or a timestamp, for the message.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.execData: The bytecode to be executed by the account contract.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.gasPrice: The gas price agreed for the relayed call.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.gasLimit: The gas reserved for the relayed call.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.gasToken: The token in which the gas will be paid.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.params.gasRelayer: The authorized beneficiary of the gas refund.
fn.executeGasRelayMsg.returns.message: The packed message bytes to be signed.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.desc: Returns the EIP-191 version of the executeGasRelay message, used both for signing and for verifying the execution on-chain.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.nonce: The execution nonce, or a timestamp, for the message.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.execD: The bytecode to be executed by the account contract.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.gasPr: The gas price agreed for the relayed call.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.gasLi: The gas reserved for the relayed call.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.gasTo: The token in which the gas will be paid.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.params.gasRe: The authorized beneficiary of the gas refund.
fn.executeGasRelayERC191Msg.returns.mess: The EIP-191 message bytes used for signing and verification.
fn.lastNonce.desc: Returns the current nonce for gas-relayed messages; a valid message must use the last nonce plus one, which prevents replay and out-of-order execution.
fn.lastNonce.returns.nonce: The current gas-relay nonce for the account.
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.name: Gas Relay Walkthrough
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.desc: Follow a gasless transaction from the owner's off-chain signature through relay submission to the relayer's token refund.
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.step.sign: The account owner signs the executeGasRelay message off-chain and hands it to a relayer, without spending any ETH.
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.step.submit: The relayer submits executeGasRelay() on-chain, fronting the ETH needed to run the transaction.
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.step.execute: The account contract validates the signature, increments its nonce, and executes the encoded call data.
sim.gasRelayWalkthrough.step.refund: The contract pays the relayer gasSpent × gasPrice in the chosen gas token, reimbursing the fronted gas.
